title: PUT /tournaments/:id/live-activity request
description: An iOS Live Activity's own push token (ActivityKit's pushTokenUpdates), for round `round` of this tournament. One per phone and tournament: a later one replaces it. The server pushes the round's count as the activity's ContentState {done, total} (games with a result, games; byes are not games) when results come in - at most one update per twenty seconds - and ends the activity once every game has a result. DELETE /tournaments/:id/live-activity forgets it (the app ended it).
